description: A woman with long black hair kneels on a tatami floor in a dark patterned silk robe with striped hems, writing with a brush on a sheet of paper laid on a low black lacquer table. A lit paper lantern stands at the left of the table beside an inkstone and a small box. Painted folding screens with plant motifs fill the background, and the room is dim and warm-lit. The costume (layered court robes, long loose hair), the tatami and the lantern suggest an early Japanese court setting. The brushed marks on the paper look like lines of script but no letter or numeral is legible, and there is no signature, frame or border; the painting runs edge to edge.
